Jlb & Associates Inc decreased its stake in Hanesbrands (HBI) by 36.72% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Jlb & Associates Inc who had been investing in Hanesbrands for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $6.56 billion market cap company. (NYSE:HBI) has declined 8.16% since May 27, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 19.71% the S&P500.
